title: A lost passport
instructions: Turist Lena kayıp pasaportu için konsolosluğa gidiyor. Uzun bir diyalog; gerekenleri, süreyi ve ücreti takip et. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: officer
script.text: Good morning. How can I help?

script.speaker: lena
script.text: I think someone stole my passport yesterday. I was at the market, and my bag was open.

script.speaker: officer
script.text: I'm sorry. Have you told the police?

script.speaker: lena
script.text: Yes, I went to the police station last night. Here is the police report.

script.speaker: officer
script.text: Good. When are you flying home?

script.speaker: officer
script.text: Then we can give you an emergency passport. It's valid for one trip only.

script.speaker: lena
script.text: What do you need from me?

script.speaker: officer
script.text: Two photos, the police report, and a copy of your flight ticket.

script.speaker: lena
script.text: I have the report and the ticket, but no photos.

script.speaker: officer
script.text: There's a photo machine at the station across the road.

script.speaker: officer
script.text: If you bring everything before twelve, you can collect it tomorrow afternoon. It costs one hundred euros.

questions.prompt: Where was Lena when her passport was stolen?
questions.evidence: I was at the market, and my bag was open.

questions.feedback: Üç gün sonra, perşembe günü uçuyor.

questions.prompt: What is special about the emergency passport?
options: It's valid for one trip only.
questions.feedback: Acil pasaport sadece tek bir yolculuk için geçerli.
questions.evidence: It's valid for one trip only.

questions.prompt: What does Lena need to get?
questions.feedback: Rapor ve bileti var; fotoğrafı yok.
questions.evidence: I have the report and the ticket, but no photos.

questions.prompt: How much does the emergency passport cost?
